site.intro.en.text:
I turn audience insight into creative that converts — and build AI tools to do it faster.
translate performance data into creative insights that inform iterations and new concepts

nodes.xbox-launch.summary.en.text: Structured a creative test for Genshin Impact's Xbox launch paid campaign to move console players from interest to landing-page action. Delivered 120M+ impressions, 52M+ video views, a 338% CTR lift versus the earlier benchmark.

nodes.xbox-launch.sections.0.items.0.en.text: The goal was to improve CTR and identify high-performing creatives. We had to turn existing brand materials into 100+ localized assets, our team’s largest creative test batch for a paid brand campaign. This required clear briefing and close coordination across languages, platform specs, and approvals.

nodes.xbox-launch.sections.1.items.0.en.text: Set the creative thesis: Used past campaign learnings and regional player insights to develop four testable creative concepts, adapting messaging for NA, FR, and DE audiences.

nodes.xbox-launch.sections.1.items.1.en.text: Coordinated creative production: Wrote detailed briefs covering copy, landing-page links, and platform specs for 144 localized assets, coordinating production timelines, reviews, and approvals.

nodes.xbox-launch.sections.1.items.2.en.text: Supported media planning and optimization: Helped shape budget allocation, regional priorities, and targeting across YouTube, Meta, X, and TikTok. Reviewed live performance with the media team to scale winning ads and pause underperformers.

nodes.xbox-launch.results.1.en.text: lower CPC versus the earlier benchmark

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.summary.en.text: I led the brand team's creative strategy for Genshin Impact's user acquisition, building a creator-led ad pipeline across Japan, North America and Europe. Our creatives delivered ~3.7× projected LTV and 26% higher projected 365-day ROI than the UA benchmark.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.sections.0.it.text: The UA team's tests showed creator ads scaled and converted well, but they couldn't produce enough of them. The brand team had creator resources but had never worked on user acquisition.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.sections.1.it.text: Built and evolved the testing framework: Translated acquisition goals into market-specific creative hypotheses, using performance data to steer tests across hooks, creative angles, scripts and formats.
Directed creator production: Briefed creators, developed script templates and reviewed every video before launch.
Built an AI-assisted iteration system: Vibe-coded a dashboard that automates creative tagging and performance analysis, surfaces winning patterns, and turns them into reusable scripts and playbooks.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.label.en.text: Zenless Zone Zero: Organic Growth in Japan

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.summary.en.text: I took over an early network of gaming content channels for Zenless Zone Zero in Japan and grew it into 9 channels with 80M+ organic views, while cutting cost per view by over half.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.0.items.0.text: After launch, Zenless Zone Zero needed steady discovery in Japan beyond its official accounts. The team had little experience growing channels like these in Japan, so I had to learn the market while testing what worked, then turn scattered experiments into a system the brand team could run on its own, all within a limited timeframe.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.team.en.text: Me (creative strategy, brand team), 1 UA strategist, 1 UA specialist and 4 agency partners. The UA team owned media buying and budget; I owned creative strategy and production.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.team.en.text: Me (social strategy), 2 Japanese content reviewers and 3 agency partners

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.0.text: Defined the channel strategy: Researched Japanese player behavior, competitor channels and content gaps to give each channel a clear niche and content pillars across YouTube and X.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.1.text: Ran biweekly growth reviews: Tracked every channel against its KPIs, diagnosed the ones falling behind and stepped in to redirect them.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.2.text: Managed agency partners: Coordinated three agencies, aligning briefs, reviews and performance targets to lift content quality and cost efficiency.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.a.text: Handed over a self-running system: Codified content learnings, KPIs and routines into playbooks, and transferred all nine channels to the brand team.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.sections.1.it.text: Strengthened creator sourcing: Expanded regional talent pools through agency pitches and rotation, matching creators to the formats they perform best.

nodes.ua-creative-strategy.sections.0.it.text: I had to build the Brand-to-UA pipeline from scratch and prove, within a few game updates, that our creatives could earn spend and bring in quality players, not just add volume. The budget only covered smaller creators, so the content itself had to do the work.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.sections.1.items.a.text: Adapted winning formats: Identified the formats driving growth in each niche and brought them to stalled channels to restart growth. For example, I moved X channels from memes toward dense, one-page guides.

nodes.zzz-jp-accounts.results.added-2f6c.text: Channels hitting view targets at handover
